title: Average, the wood is thin…
text:
Average, the wood is thin…. [[VIDEOID:ffe883624f9d569c36f4b71658259b4f]] The good and the bad:

The good:
Easy assemble
Folds up and is very compact
The metal rails won’t mildew
The wood is nicely stained and sealed

The bad:
The wood is thin
Very wobbly base

The poles do fit in the base. You have to takes the screws out of the poles and use them for assembly. I will continue to use this rack for small clothes items that aren’t to heavy when wet.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
